answer: The mirror counter is kept in inlet and copper shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 16 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An copycat therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 16 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 972 identities would post 4810 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
